input.notes: ACTIVE ASSIGNMENT: repo-hierarchical-audit-v2 (supersedes repo-requirements-audit-v1; v1 PR #226 merged at main 38ca4c1d). Branch venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2, base main, assignment_sha 8e75e4f7f1e0ccf926392cca31246dcdacf1fd8b. allow_merge=true, publishing_enabled=true, deliverable=merged_pr. allowed_paths: docs/venice-audit-v1/**, agent/repo_requirements_audit_validate.py, tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py, .github/workflows/venice-repo-requirements-audit.yml. Current main head observed: main@7020524ba68ed49932e2c72ce721993991d9cd99 (bridge also lists main@8405b21d and main@db3d5404 as accepted identities). Spec blob: agent/tasks/REPO_REQUIREMENTS_AUDIT_V1.md@db3d5404a4a962b475de51c17f45611541674c60 (96 lines, 16841 chars; first 48 lines read, next_offset 7230). REQUIRED v2 OUTPUTS per spec: README.md (single entry point, snapshot/as-of, links); GANTT.md (hierarchical stage/substage table, percentages ONLY on substage rows, counts allowed all levels, no fabricated dates); GANTT.html or GANTT.svg visual counterpart from same source tables; STAGES.csv (node_id,parent_id,node_type(stage/substage),title,status,substage_percent,percent_numerator,percent_denominator,percent_basis,blockers,next_action,evidence_refs,details_path; percent fields blank on stage rows); REQUIREMENTS.csv granular master with requirement_id,parent_substage_id,subject_id plus 8 status fields (scope_definition_status, data_acquisition_status, strict_data_definition_status, implementation_status, question_design_status, answer_generation_status, verification_status, main_acceptance_status) with explicit states NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL/COMPLETE/BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED/NOT_APPLICABLE + explanation, authority, acceptance, scope, evidence, missing work, dependencies, owner, next action; details/<substage-id>.md per substage; QUESTION_INDEX.csv (or sharded questions/ + index manifest) with canonical IDs, parent_substage_id, subject_id, literal predicate or template+parameter ranges, source ref, design/implementation/answer/verification states; existing DATA_REQUIREMENTS.csv, GANTT_COMPARISON.csv, EVIDENCE.json, AUDIT.md, PROGRESS.json remain required and must cross-reference the hierarchy. VISUAL RULE: one actual visual Gantt per substage node in STAGES.csv showing ALL required children and each phase-specific status (including not started/blocked/unknown), reconciled to full requirement/question coverage index; at minimum distinct views for data scope/selection, data fetching, strict data/indicator definition, question design, question asking, plus downstream substages; SVG preferred. Hierarchy: large stage > substage > granular item/question with parent_id and subject_id cross-refs; broad green rows must never hide incomplete children. Percentages only per substage with numerator/denominator/scope/basis, else UNKNOWN; never use controller overall percentage as project completion. Persist staged findings incrementally. Existing branch artifacts (reuse, do not delete): DATA_REQUIREMENTS.csv@531b1d19 (322980B), REQUIREMENTS.csv@78ee06ad (14000B), GANTT_COMPARISON.csv@4220cfdf (30935B), EVIDENCE.json (regenerated by workflow each push), SOURCE_MANIFEST.json@c4755f36, AUDIT.md@dbdf9d97, GANTT.html@db4e7073, build_matrices.py@99818667, build_extra.py@352110f9, build_gantt.py@5bf023d0, .gitignore@7f6ff296, PROGRESS.json@b3c23c40. Missing on branch: README.md, GANTT.md, STAGES.csv, QUESTION_INDEX.csv, details/, charts/CHART_INDEX.csv. Pitfalls: (1) stale-v1-progress — PROGRESS.json still says task_id repo-requirements-audit-v1/current_subtask t5; must rewrite for v2 using live SHA. (2) committed-pycache still open — docs/venice-audit-v1/__pycache__ is tracked; .gitignore does not untrack; needs git rm -r --cached in workflow commit step (no accepted evidence identity supplied this turn, so not listed below until a fresh read returns its sha). (3) Workflow .github/workflows/venice-repo-requirements-audit.yml auto-commits regenerated matrices, so re-read every docs file immediately before editing; never write on stale SHA. (4) Job HTML logs truncated — use run_jobs conclusions + check-run annotations. Open questions: authoritative 258-kind inventory path (docs/INVENTORY_CATALOG_AUDIT_V1.json vs dictionary/WORLD_SNAPSHOT_DICTIONARY.csv) and 233/~296 count reconciliation; owner authority excluding Finviz live-only and GDELT. Do not infer completion from catalog rows or green jobs; unknown coverage stays UNKNOWN.
